method: Every selected original Hebrew record and every annotation read before independent drafting. All TSW comparator verses read afterward. Every verse has an individually authored rationale; no synonym-substitution engine or change quota used.
qualification: Authoring reread by the drafting agent; not independent scholarly approval.
companion_impact: Quotations and bindings for the changed chapters require later reconciliation. Companion not modified.
comparator_limitations: Overlap uses normalized verse text and serves only as triage.
